title: LLM request (canonical form)
description: llm.LlmRequest in its canonical form, CanonicalRequest.json: every field, sorted keys, responseSchema written as null when absent; the optional thinking, topP and topK are written only when set (interface proposal v5, D1), so a request without them keeps the eight-field text and hash. The SHA-256 of Canonical.text of this object is the cache key and the requestHash of CallRecord. $defs also give the two derived wire forms: the OpenAI-compatible HTTP body (OpenAiCompatibleClient.body) and one line of the append-only cache file (CacheFile.line).

provider.description: Provider label (LlmSettings.provider); always 'openai-compatible' from the CLI, hard-coded in LlmCommands.settings for every base URL (INTERFACES.md f.7, F20). Part of the hash and so of the cache key; not sent on the wire. A second backend must use its own label.

modelSnapshot.description: The served model name, sent as 'model'; with provider, the model identity (INTERFACES.md f.1). The deploy recipe serves <org>--<name>--<40-hex revision>+vllm<version>[-<tag>]. LlmSettings rejects a blank id; the CLI accepts only printable ASCII without spaces.

system.description: System prompt: PromptBuilder.gameSystem(ctx) for game and probe calls, PromptBuilder.VIGNETTE_SYSTEM for vignette calls.

turns.description: 1 turn (first attempt) or 3 turns (repair retry: user, assistant = the unreadable reply, user = REPAIR_TEXT; probe: user, assistant = the decision text, user = PROBE_QUESTION).

responseSchema.description: JSON Schema text of the expected reply: DECISION_SCHEMA (game), CHOICE_SCHEMA (vignette), null (probe).

thinking.description: Optional (C12a.1): the chat-template thinking switch (--thinking on|off), sent as chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking. Absent = unset: nothing is sent and the hash is the eight-field one.

topP.description: Optional (C12a.1, --top-p): sent as top_p; absent = unset.

topK.description: Optional (C12a.1, --top-k): sent as top_k; >= 1, or -1 for no limit; absent = unset.

drawKey.description: Names the draw: game|<scenarioId>|s<runSeed>|<seatId>|r<round>|a<attempt>, probe|<scenarioId>|s<runSeed>|<seatId>|r<round>, vig|<scenarioId>|s<seed>|p<paraphrase>|row<rowIndex>|b<b/G %.4f>|c<collusive letter>|d<draw>|a<attempt>. Part of the hash; sent as 'user'; seeds the provider ('seed' = OpenAiCompatibleClient.seedOf).

wireBody.title: POST {baseUrl}/v1/chat/completions body
wireBody.description: OpenAiCompatibleClient.body(request), sorted keys. messages[0] is the system message, then the turns in order.

seed.description: OpenAiCompatibleClient.seedOf(drawKey) = int(first 8 hex digits of SHA-256(drawKey), base 16) & 0x7FFFFFFF: the first 4 bytes read big-endian with the leading bit cleared (not the first 31 bits; the code javadoc is wrong, INTERFACES.md F21).

chat_template_kwargs.description: Present only when the request's thinking is set (C12a.1); false is sent explicitly, because Qwen3 thinks by default.

top_p.description: Present only when the request's topP is set.

top_k.description: Present only when the request's topK is set.

response_format.description: Present only when responseSchema is non-null.

name.description: 'talk' for a talk call (draw key talk|..., C5.5, proposal B1: the talk reply schema); otherwise always 'decision', also for the vignette choice schema; no 'strict' flag is sent.

cacheLine.title: One line of the append-only cache (CacheFile.line)
cacheLine.description: Sorted keys. Loading requires only hash and text; tokensIn/tokensOut/finishReason default to 0/0/'', reasoning/reasoningTokens to null. The first line for a hash wins (putIfAbsent).

text.description: The completion text, byte-identical to what the server returned (choices[0].message.content). Backend obligation: non-null; a null text would be written as null and CacheFile.load would then reject the whole file.

finishReason.description: Backend obligation (INTERFACES.md f.7): a non-null string, '' when unknown. CacheFile.line would write null for a backend that returns null, which this schema rejects.

modelSnapshot.description: The served model name of the request (INTERFACES.md f.1); the hash already covers it, this copy labels the line.

reasoning.description: Optional (C12a.2): the server's separate reasoning text (message.reasoning_content, else message.reasoning), written only when the reply carried one; never part of text. Absent on every line of a model without reasoning, so those lines keep the seven keys.

reasoningTokens.description: Optional (C12a.2): usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens, written only when the server reported it.
